answer: Because the timing is entered against the ridge challenge, the beacon audit can replay the haven history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 267 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. Each duplicate costs another 168 dollars in locked collateral and another 4 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
